name: Samurott
flavor: Samurott leads its group strictly. Those who do not follow its rules receive a merciless thrashing.

ability.name: Stance
ability.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks from your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon until the end of your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Pike
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
